Q: Thank you for tkaing the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision in Pearland,
Texas?
A: Yes, I was driving my own car.
Q: Walk me through what you were doing right before the impact.
A: I was turning left at the intersection, heading into the parking lot of a strip center. I had my blinker on and I was
waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic.
Q: How did the other vehicle approach?
A: It came through from the opposite direction, and I thought it was far enough away. I started my turn and then it hit
the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started moving?
A: I saw headlights, but they looked like they were a good distance back. I misjudged it, I think.
Q: Were there any traffic signals at that intersection?
A: There was a signal, and I believe my light was green for the turn arrow to clear. Honestly, I'm not one hundred
percent sure how long it had been changing.
Q: Did you feel any pain at the scene?
A: Not right away. My neck started to feel stiff and sore later that evening, and by the next morning it was hard to turn
my head.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the accident?
A: Yes, I went in for an evaluation a couple of days later. They said I have a neck strain and gave me a treatment
plan.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about how the collision happened?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping to get my car repaired and get some relief from the neck pain.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
